name: Kevin T. Hayakawa
office: Rowland Unified School District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Kevin T. Hayakawa is Vice President of the Rowland Unified School District Board of Education, elected by the board to represent Trustee Area 5 in 2022. He is a physics professor in the California State University system. He is a graduate of Rowland Unified schools and holds a Ph.D. in astronomy and astrophysics from UCLA. He previously served as a board member for the Walnut Valley Water District from 2020 to 2022. His campaign says he has worked to increase public transparency, promote student voice, reduce classroom distractions, lower student-to-teacher ratios, improve test scores, and oppose data centers near schools.
